title: Pocketwire Rewards Protection Multiplier on the Purchase Protection Ceiling
content:
Pocketwire Rewards members on the upper tiers enjoy a higher purchase protection ceiling on their Pocketwire Personal Account.

**Rule.** The rewards protection multiplier on the protection ceiling reads the customer's Pocketwire Rewards membership: 2 (that is, 2.0) for an active membership on the Pocketwire Rewards Diamond or Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian tier, 1.5 for an active membership on the Pocketwire Rewards Gold or Pocketwire Rewards Platinum tier, and 1 for any other membership or none. The protection ceiling is multiplied by this figure.

| Pocketwire Rewards membership | Multiplier on the protection ceiling |
|---|---|
| Active, Pocketwire Rewards Diamond or Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 2.0 |
| Active, Pocketwire Rewards Gold or Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 1.5 |
| Active, Pocketwire Rewards Member or Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 1 |
| Any status other than active, on any tier | 1 |
| No membership | 1 |

**Illustration (hypothetical ceiling of 5000.00):** 10000.00 with a multiplier of 2.0, 7500.00 with 1.5, and 5000.00 with 1.
